вставать.gloss: to get up, to stand up

meanings.en: to get up, to stand up
meanings.note: Prefix 'вс-' ('up') marks upward or sudden onset of action (root 'тавать'). Used in Russian as an imperfective verb expressing ongoing, habitual, or repeated action meaning 'to get up', forming an aspectual pair with 'встать'.
